paras: Cyrtodactylus pageli  is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Laos.
The specific name, pageli, is in honor of German zoologist Theodor Bernhard Pagel.
C. pageli is found in northwestern Laos, in Vientiane Province.
The preferred natural habitats of C. pageli are forest and dry caves, at altitudes of 260–300 m (850–980 ft).
Medium-sized for its genus, C. pageli may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 8 cm (3.1 in).
The mode of reproduction of C. pageli is unknown.
